name: Clam
tagline: Fold your phone shut, and your distracting apps stay shut. A one-tap focus blocker built on Apple's Screen Time API.

name: Good Walk
tagline: A dog walk tracker with a daily streak. One tap from the reminder, your dog's photo on everything. No collar, no map, no account.
status: In development · App Store launch 1–7 October

name: Cartworth
tagline: Compare grocery prices at every store near you, anywhere in the US. Every price is converted to the same unit so package sizes compare fairly, plus each store's weekly ad.

name: Damp
tagline: Drink less, not never. A one-tap dry-night tracker that counts your streak, the money you kept and the calories you skipped. No account, nothing leaves the phone.

name: LaunchNeat
tagline: A small business: real websites for local shops. $99 the first year, $50 after that, domain and a year of care included.

name: Lume
tagline: A daily glow coach. One photo, a glow score, and a sixty-second skincare ritual. Photos never leave the phone.

name: SignalRig
tagline: A GTM engineering showcase: five working demos of enrichment, scoring, routing, signal detection and reporting, plus a prompt lab.
